verdict.rationale: Lindy is an automation platform with routines and skills, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence describes creating routines (lindy-docs-19) and saving skills (lindy-docs-6), but nothing covers version history, change review, or rollback of those automations. The GitHub mention (lindy-docs-16) is about Lindy tracing changes in a user's code, not versioning its own automations, so it does not count here.
